description: NEW JERSEY – Today, Congressman Rob Menendez was endorsed for re-election by ASPIRE PAC, the political arm of the Democratic Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander (AANHPI) Members of Congress. “Rob Menendez has been an outspoken champion and vital ally for Asian Americans, Native Hawaiians, and Pacific Islanders in New Jersey and across the country,” said […]

title: ASPIRE PAC Endorses Congressman Rob Menendez for Re-Election - Rob Menendez
